title: 曝光焦距與劑量控制
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究焦點劑量定義、窗口量測、感測與補償、變異與接受；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: focus and dose, window measurement, sensing and correction, variation and acceptance. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

stages.title: 焦點劑量定義
stages.description: 焦距與劑量影響不同但會共同改變顯影輪廓。
stages.descriptionEn: Focus and dose have distinct effects that jointly change developed contours.

steps.title: 定義名目焦點與離焦符號
steps.titleEn: Define nominal focus and defocus signs
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：焦點需有一致的參考面。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Focus needs a consistent reference plane.
steps.instruction: 定義名目焦點與離焦符號。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。附上帶材料、方向與尺度標記的示意圖，圈出一處不能由圖單獨推論的量。最後以「焦點需有一致的參考面。」檢查推論是否超出證據。
steps.instructionEn: Define nominal focus and defocus signs. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: Focus needs a consistent reference plane.
steps.observation: 焦點需有一致的參考面。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
steps.observationEn: Focus needs a consistent reference plane. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「焦距與劑量是完全相同的控制量。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "Focus and dose are the same control variable.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check: 交付「定義名目焦點與離焦符號」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「焦點需有一致的參考面。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the diagram, table or calculation for "Define nominal focus and defocus signs", with sources, assumptions and units. Identify evidence supporting "Focus needs a consistent reference plane." and retain one limitation.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜接班建模：先寫出不能推論的事
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Shift intake: state what the evidence cannot prove
knowledge.text:
以「曝光焦距與劑量控制」為本次任務邊界，閱讀「定義名目焦點與離焦符號」後，先列出輸入、輸出與量測單位。特別檢查：最佳焦點單點不代表足夠焦點劑量製程窗口。將已知、模型假設與未量測項目分開，再進入「黃光任務：解析度、套刻與缺陷」整合遊戲。

需留下的證據：任務邊界表：曝光焦距與劑量控制 的資料版本、單位、輸入／輸出及一項不能由現有證據支持的結論。

驗證與交接：能用自己的話解釋為何「最佳焦點單點不代表足夠焦點劑量製程窗口」，且沒有把猜測寫成實測。
knowledge.textEn:
Use Exposure focus and dose control as the task boundary. After reading “Define nominal focus and defocus signs”, list inputs, outputs and measurement units. Check specifically: One best-focus point does not establish an adequate focus-dose window. Separate known data, model assumptions and unmeasured items before entering “Yellow-light mission: resolution, overlay and defects”.

Evidence to retain: Boundary sheet for Exposure focus and dose control: data version, units, inputs/outputs and one unsupported conclusion.

Verification and handover: Explain why “One best-focus point does not establish an adequate focus-dose window” and do not present assumptions as measurements.

quiz.question: 完成「定義名目焦點與離焦符號」後，哪項判讀可靠？

焦距與劑量是完全相同的控制量。
只用一種圖形即可代表所有版圖。
optionsEn: Focus needs a consistent reference plane.
Focus and dose are the same control variable.
quiz.explanation: 焦點需有一致的參考面。 焦距與劑量影響不同但會共同改變顯影輪廓。
quiz.explanationEn: Focus needs a consistent reference plane. Focus and dose have distinct effects that jointly change developed contours.
